description_en: Describes the versions to which an SQL Server instance or a specified SQL Server version can be upgraded
description_zh: 描述SQLServer实例或指定SQLServer版本允许升级到的版本
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-sql-server-upgrade-versions --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOC0000 --db-instance-id rm-xx1xxx20000 --engine-version 2016_web --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSQLServerUpgradeVersions

parameters.description_en:
This parameter ensures the idempotence of the request to prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests.

The value consists of ASCII characters, contains no more than 64 characters, and must not include non-ASCII characters.
parameters.description_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由 ASCII 字符组成，最长不超过 64 个字符，不能包含非 ASCII 字符。
